frame: In ./todo-list there's a NodeGX app, a todo list. Make me my own NodeGX editor for it, in ./editor. {wish} It should open the app's folder, let me change the app, and save my changes back into the app's files without breaking them. Build it with the NodeGX kit from npm, and make it start with one npm command. Don't change ./todo-list yourself: I'll make my changes in the editor, so test on copies. Please just build it without waiting for me to answer questions. When you're done, write the report the kit asks for into ./REPORT.md instead of opening an issue.

strangers.table: I want a table: one row per node, one column per port, and I edit the cells to change the app. Nothing visual at all.
strangers.blocks: I want a big-block editor my children can use: few nodes, huge targets, no jargon.
strangers.map: I want to see my project as a 3D map I can fly through, and rewire it there.
